title: FILTER over the fact table, as a CALCULATE filter, filters the related dimensions too
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Products", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), FILTER ( Sales, Sales[Quantity] >= 3 ) ), "Customers", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Customer ), FILTER ( Sales, Sales[Quantity] >= 3 ) ) )

source.quote: when you place a filter on Sales, it results in applying the filter not only on the Sales table, but also on the Product table
source.supports: a filter on Sales is also a filter on Product, and on every table Sales expands to

derivation: Sales rows with Quantity >= 3: row 4 (5) and row 6 (3). Both are product 3 (Lock): 1 product. Their customers are 2 and 3: 2 customers.
